label: Mid/late copy-phase steps in long sequences (recall position >= 3, 1-5 outputs left)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only on repeated inputs (never in_first). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases. Activity is concentrated on long sequences (L=7-9 hold about 93% of the mass) at recall positions 3-6, peaking at recall_idx 4-5 (t=12-14). It is almost silent with 6 or more outputs still to go. The strongest activations sit around recall_idx 3-4 of L=9 sequences. Within this window it is sparse (about 16% precision), and token identity modulates whether it fires: out_tok z/f/1/p and prev_tok m/a/b raise the rate 3-6x. A token-list refinement did not give a clean rule (F1 0.39), so the positional window covers most activation mass but does not say which steps inside it fire.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: z, f, 1, p, o, x; least: k, a, -, y) and the next token to output (most: f, z, 1, x, q, o; least: r, y, a, k); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3.
